desc: Establish reduction: shortest palindrome prefix extension is S + reverse(S[:n-L]) where L is the longest palindromic suffix of S.
Choose primary O(n) algorithm: KMP prefix function on reverse(S) + separator + S.
Implement the KMP-based solution with O(n) string handling for n up to 500000.
Test samples ABC, Z, TREE plus edge cases: n=1, all-equal, already palindrome, L=n and L=1.
Validate O(n) time/O(n) memory and correctness of index mapping for L.
